elements_selected.content: Pure-core modules per SPEC-034 §8 purity boundary map: `src/cap/derivation.rs` (HKDF path-cap + wrap-key derivation per CON-3401), `src/cap/url_format.rs` (cap URL rendering + parsing), `src/cap/grants/validation.rs` (schema + invariants with `deny_unknown_fields`), `src/cap/recipients/parsing.rs` (age-recipient-v1 only per REQ-3409), `src/cap/scoping/cohort_index.rs` (cohort-to-pages assignment). No I/O, no randomness. Property-based tests on derivation (deterministic, secret/cohort/slug/epoch separation). Mutation testing ≥ 90% kill rate on derivation + url_format.
